title: Write to Freedom persisted document contracts
description: Select a document definition under $defs using its key. These schemas describe normalized JSON storage, not API request envelopes or database rows. Domain validators additionally enforce ownership, legacy compatibility, cross-field equality and aggregate UTF-16/byte limits. String maxLength is the portable code-point bound; runtime UTF-16 limits can be stricter.

x-metadata.id: Immutable SQL identity (virtual sample IDs map to private storage).
x-metadata.ownerId: Authenticated owner_id; never accepted from editable forms.
x-metadata.version: SQL safe positive revision, distinct from schemaVersion. Version 0 exists only for virtual profiles.
x-metadata.createdAt: UTC ISO timestamp on primary entity rows, when available.
x-metadata.updatedAt: UTC ISO edit timestamp; null for old generic-location profiles with unknown historical edit time.

birthDate.title: Birth date
birthDate.description: Author-entered story date. Precision, era, approximation, or custom calendar text are preserved; chronological interpretation is derived.

age.title: Age
age.description: Numeric text, including the author’s formatting. Empty means unrecorded. Compatibility validation uses JavaScript Number conversion and requires a finite nonnegative value; age must be a whole number. Text inputs retain accepted legacy notation without browser number-input sanitization. Height and weight use their corresponding unit field.

exposition.title: What must the reader understand before this arc begins?

expositionStatusQuo.title: What does normal life look like at this point?

expositionPressure.title: What tension is already building beneath the surface?

incitingIncident.title: What event disrupts the status quo?

incitingIncidentImpact.title: Why can the central characters no longer ignore it?

incitingIncidentChoice.title: What immediate choice or commitment follows?

risingAction.title: What obstacles make the central conflict harder?

risingActionEscalation.title: How do the characters’ choices escalate the situation?

risingActionRevelation.title: What new information changes their understanding?

climax.title: What decisive confrontation or choice occurs?

climaxCost.title: What must the central characters risk or sacrifice?

climaxAnswer.title: How does this moment answer the central dramatic question?

fallingAction.title: What immediate consequences follow the climax?

fallingActionResponse.title: How do the surviving characters respond?

fallingActionLooseEnds.title: What remaining conflict still needs closure?

resolution.title: What new status quo replaces the old one?

resolutionChange.title: How have the characters or world changed?

resolutionCarryForward.title: What promise, cost, or question carries forward?

externalStakes.title: What can be lost in the world around the characters?

internalStakes.title: What can be lost within the central characters?

philosophicalStakes.title: What belief or value is being tested?

consequences.title: What happens if the central goal fails?

hiddenFields.description: Hidden field names. Their underlying content remains stored.

id.description: UUID for new scenes; deterministic arc-scoped legacy IDs remain valid.

chapter.description: Author-entered chapter label; not a manuscript chapter ID. Legacy long labels are retained.

chapterId.description: Must equal scenes.chapter_id and refer to a chapter owned by the same author.

entityReference.description: Owner-scoped discriminated reference. A note identity always includes its owning character.

position.description: UTF-16 offset of the note’s numbered marker in its source field, or null when unplaced. Marker numbering derives from array order.

characterNote.description: Ordered inline content concatenates to text (ignoring only outer whitespace). When content is present, links are derived from its references. Anchor, target existence, and aggregate length rules require domain validation.
